hero.name: Erik András Birkl.
hero.title: Software Engineer
hero.subtitle: I build clean, reliable interfaces with React and TypeScript — and I like knowing what's happening underneath them too.

about.paragraph1: I approach every interface as a product, not just a screen. My goal is to build UI/UX that is genuinely functional — fast, accessible and intuitive — while still being beautiful enough that people actually enjoy using it.
about.paragraph2: I care about the details others skip: the easing of a transition, the contrast of a label, the rhythm of the spacing. That obsession is exactly what a great engineering-meets-design product needs.
about.skill1Body: I don't just implement existing Figma prototypes. When needed, I design interfaces and user flows from scratch and translate them into clean React components.
about.skill2Body: While my core focus is frontend, I'm comfortable stepping outside my comfort zone to handle backend or infrastructure tasks whenever a project needs it.

skills.intro: From the fundamentals to the frameworks, the pipeline and the AI copilots that speed it all up.

projects.intro: A full-stack project I designed, built and shipped solo, end to end.

kerian.tagline: Full-stack e-commerce, built solo — still a work in progress.
kerian.description: A clothing e-commerce platform I'm designing and building solo as my thesis project — UI concept, database schema, REST backend and a real Stripe checkout. Customers can already browse and filter by size, colour and gender, manage a cart and wishlist, and pay by card, while I keep extending the admin side and polishing the rest.
kerian.highlightAiBody: Claude Haiku 4.5 suggests cart-matching items by style and colour — never something already in the basket.
kerian.highlightStripeBody: End-to-end online card payments, from cart to order confirmation.
kerian.highlightAdminBody: TOTP-secured admin panel with a live revenue, order and trend dashboard.
kerian.highlightInventoryBody: Pessimistic row locking keeps stock from going negative under simultaneous orders.

experience.intro: Two separate tracks — where I've worked, and where I've studied. Tap a highlighted role for the full story.

vidux.desc: Building and maintaining a React / TypeScript frontend and a reusable UI component library. Translating Figma designs into pixel-accurate interfaces and integrating backend APIs for live video in the banking sector.
vidux.detailSubtitle: IP-based security systems & video recording solutions for the banking sector.
detailBullets: Building web frontends with React / TypeScript and JavaScript, continuously improving the user experience and interface design.
Collaborating closely with designers through Figma to make sure every UI layout meets the exact specifications.
Participating in agile development processes, improving project delivery and overall team efficiency.
Integrated the frontend with backend APIs to display live video streams, device status, analytics dashboards and alarm handling.
Developed and maintained a private npm package of shared UI components — ensuring design consistency and accelerating development across multiple company projects.
Contributed to backend tasks by writing database migration scripts, helping balance team capacity and support project delivery.

accountant.desc: Accounting data entry and administration — precision, ownership and comfort working with structured data.

bartender.desc: High-pressure hospitality at one of Europe's largest festivals — speed, teamwork and grace under a crowd.

university.desc: Studied software engineering, algorithms, databases and systems, combined with plenty of hands-on project work — including a full-stack thesis project.

highschool.desc: High school with a Media specialization, where an early interest in visual communication took shape.
